7385e2b7ab8e6e0231da.en: After the first stop there are 6 - 2 + 3 = 7 people. After the second stop there are 7 - 4 = 3 people.
7385e2b7ab8e6e0231da.id: Setelah halte pertama, ada 6 - 2 + 3 = 7 orang. Setelah halte kedua, ada 7 - 4 = 3 orang.

f79893faeaf4d2eb9ab3.en: First stop: 2 get off and 3 get on.
f79893faeaf4d2eb9ab3.id: Halte pertama: 2 orang turun dan 3 orang naik.

e6a04cc8b1a7b3f6efb4.en: Remember that 2 people got off at the first stop too.
e6a04cc8b1a7b3f6efb4.id: Ingat, 2 orang juga turun di perhentian pertama.

21e97d60346a1ddfac89.en: That is after the first stop. 4 more get off later.
21e97d60346a1ddfac89.id: Itu jumlah setelah perhentian pertama. Nanti 4 orang lagi turun.

f22723c632b7e96e928d.en: At the second stop, 4 people got off. Take them away.
f22723c632b7e96e928d.id: Di perhentian kedua, 4 orang turun. Keluarkan mereka dari hitungan.

7db8b3e26f875f43213f.en: People who get off must be taken away, not added.
7db8b3e26f875f43213f.id: Orang yang turun harus dikurangi, bukan ditambah.

bf88e4795633f912e698.en: Lina is 7th, so there are 7 children from the front up to Lina. With 3 more behind her, there are 7 + 3 = 10 children.
bf88e4795633f912e698.id: Lina ada di urutan 7th, jadi ada 7 anak dari depan sampai Lina. Ditambah 3 anak di belakangnya, ada 7 + 3 = 10 anak.

6f282f3fc41ff803deea.en: Up to Lina there are 7 children, with Lina as the 7th.
6f282f3fc41ff803deea.id: Sampai Lina ada 7 anak, dan Lina di urutan 7th.

f433bd3addf2649ee8d5.id: Jadi, ada 10 anak di antrean itu.

1892d60b18eb89976dd1.en: 3 is only the children behind Lina.
1892d60b18eb89976dd1.id: 3 itu hanya anak-anak di belakang Lina.

5ca9fee4444c7b3cbf9b.en: Count everyone, not only from Lina to the back.
5ca9fee4444c7b3cbf9b.id: Hitung semua anak, jangan hanya dari Lina sampai belakang.

614612292bcf386e5a69.en: There are 6 children in front of Lina, then Lina, then 3 more.
614612292bcf386e5a69.id: Ada 6 anak di depan Lina, lalu Lina, lalu 3 anak lagi.

c6c462ceb466fb304c68.en: Lina is already counted in the 7, so do not add her again.
c6c462ceb466fb304c68.id: Lina sudah terhitung di dalam 7, jadi jangan ditambah lagi.

a8e9e28b8372f362a631.en: If Ana has 2, Ben has 4 and Cici has 6. The total is 2 + 4 + 6 = 12, so Cici has 6 marbles.
a8e9e28b8372f362a631.id: Kalau Ana punya 2, Ben punya 4 dan Cici punya 6. Jumlahnya 2 + 4 + 6 = 12, jadi Cici punya 6 kelereng.

7d40f279fcb89dc89266.en: The total is 12, so this works. Cici has 6 marbles.
7d40f279fcb89dc89266.id: Jumlahnya 12, jadi ini benar. Cici punya 6 kelereng.

681b26d7962042b9fa07.en: Then Ben would have 1, and Ana cannot have 2 fewer than 1.
681b26d7962042b9fa07.id: Kalau begitu, Ben punya 1, dan Ana tidak mungkin punya 2 lebih sedikit daripada 1.

48c9ba37f393fed41b20.en: If Cici has 5, Ben has 3 and Ana has 1. That is only 9 marbles.
48c9ba37f393fed41b20.id: Kalau Cici punya 5, Ben punya 3 dan Ana punya 1. Itu hanya 9 kelereng.

55783b348b5e68841dc3.en: There are 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16 chairs. 9 are taken, so 16 - 9 = 7 chairs are empty.
55783b348b5e68841dc3.id: Ada 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 = 16 kursi. 9 kursi sudah terisi, jadi 16 - 9 = 7 kursi kosong.

6d5efdbc5b86e9e792fb.en: 9 is the number of children sitting down, not the empty chairs.
6d5efdbc5b86e9e792fb.id: 9 adalah jumlah anak yang duduk, bukan jumlah kursi kosong.

e9ac6c28d6a539d5c78f.en: 16 is all the chairs. Some of them are taken.
e9ac6c28d6a539d5c78f.id: 16 adalah semua kursi. Sebagian kursi sudah diduduki.

86b96a40fa44fd910bc8.en: Taken chairs must be taken away, not added.
86b96a40fa44fd910bc8.id: Kursi yang sudah diduduki harus dikurangi, bukan ditambah.

49c02b294a66ceff76a6.en: 5 trees in a row have 4 gaps between them. Each gap is 2 metres, so the distance is 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 8 metres.
49c02b294a66ceff76a6.id: 5 pohon yang berbaris punya 4 jarak di antaranya. Setiap jarak panjangnya 2 meter, jadi jauhnya 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 8 meter.

063a82060317c29430a4.en: Draw the trees and the gaps.
063a82060317c29430a4.id: Gambar pohon-pohon dan jarak di antaranya.

41be7558f6d1a5d7c610.en: Before eating, Ella had 3 + 2 = 5 sweets. That was half of her sweets, so at first she had 5 + 5 = 10 sweets.
41be7558f6d1a5d7c610.id: Sebelum makan, Ella punya 3 + 2 = 5 permen. Itu setengah dari permennya, jadi awalnya Ella punya 5 + 5 = 10 permen.

f3e9807bae53af6c4982.en: At the end Ella has 3 sweets.

cfa66b1f1d6d48acad74.en: 5 is the half she kept. The other half is also 5.
cfa66b1f1d6d48acad74.id: 5 adalah setengah yang disimpan Ella. Setengah lainnya juga 5.

1a537b8ac38587e7aa64.en: The frog lands on 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. That is 5 jumps.
1a537b8ac38587e7aa64.id: Katak mendarat di 2, 4, 6, 8, dan 10. Itu 5 lompatan.

50573e77b28aa7cb5a82.en: The opposite of adding 4 is taking away 4. 9 - 4 = 5. Check: 5 + 4 = 9.
50573e77b28aa7cb5a82.id: Kebalikan dari menambah 4 adalah mengurangi 4. 9 - 4 = 5. Periksa: 5 + 4 = 9.

e5aa68885b7a66a68eaf.en: The opposite of adding 4 is taking away 4.

f2cf9aa1399f00accb9d.en: Take away Ali's extra 2: 12 - 2 = 10. Share equally: 5 each. Ali has 5 + 2 = 7 pencils.
f2cf9aa1399f00accb9d.id: Ambil dulu kelebihan 2 pensil milik Ali: 12 - 2 = 10. Bagi sama rata: masing-masing 5. Ali punya 5 + 2 = 7 pensil.

8d183093d1f8dcb08724.id: Ambil dulu kelebihan 2 pensil milik Ali: 12 - 2 = 10.

6ae37e94584f5b16538e.en: Before she got 5 more she had 9 - 5 = 4. Before she ate 3 she had 4 + 3 = 7 sweets.
6ae37e94584f5b16538e.id: Sebelum mendapat 5 lagi, Rani punya 9 - 5 = 4. Sebelum makan 3, Rani punya 4 + 3 = 7 permen.

6591d778fac8387c1619.en: Before she got 5 more she had 9 - 5 = 4.

77ed1b7baeb8d7acd893.en: Before she ate 3 she had 4 + 3 = 7 sweets.
